pages.text_en:
Monduli district council History
Monduli District is one of the six districts of the Arusha Region of Tanzania. It is located in the northeastern section of the country. It is bordered to the north by Kenya, to the east by the Kilimanjaro Region and Arumeru District, to the south by the Manyara Region and to the west by Ngorongoro District and Karatu District. The town of Monduli is the administrative seat of the district. According to the 2002 Tanzania National Census, the population of the Monduli District was 185,237 The word Monduli was originated in the ward MonduliJuu. There was a wealthy Maasai ancestor with the name of Monduli, who lived in the area during the times of German colonization. The Germans colonized Tanzania in 1880s. They brought European education with them, teaching the areas of science, math, engineering, and even German. Tanzania gained their independence in December 9, 1961, under the leadership of President Julius Nyerere.
General Information
The Monduli District Council established during the British Colonial Rule where the administrative area was named "Monduli Maasai District” at that time was included with the present Kiteto, Simanjiro, Ngorongoro and Longido districts.
In 1979 the present Kiteto district was born out of the Monduli Maasai district (then the present Simanjiro district was still part of Kiteto district) since then the name of the District remained “Monduli”- the present Ngorongoro district was still part of it until 1980s.
In 2005 Longido District was also born out of Monduli District. Therefore, Monduli district council is one of the seven district councils of Arusha Region. Monduli District is situated between latitudes 3.00” to 4.50’ South of the Equator and Longitudes 36.50’ to 36.45’ East of Greenwich Meridian.
BORDERS
It is bordered by Arumeru Diricts to the East, Ngorongoro and Karatu Districts to the West, Mbulu and Babati to the South and Simanjiro District to the South-East and Longido district to the North.

Historia ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Monduli
Wilaya ya Monduli ni mojawapo ya wilaya sita za Mkoa wa Arusha Region nchini Tanzania. Iko katika sehemu ya kaskazini mashariki ya nchi. Wilaya hii inapakana na nchi ya Kenya upande wa kaskazini; upande wa mashariki inapakana na Kilimanjaro Region pamoja na Wilaya ya Arumeru District; upande wa kusini inapakana na Manyara Region; na upande wa magharibi inapakana na Wilaya za Ngorongoro District na Karatu District. Mji wa Monduli Town ndio makao makuu ya kiutawala ya wilaya.
Kwa mujibu wa Sensa ya Taifa ya mwaka 2002 ya Tanzania, wakazi wa Wilaya ya Monduli walikuwa 185,237. Jina Monduli linatokana na Kata ya Monduli Juu. Inasemekana kuwa kulikuwa na babu tajiri wa Kimaasai aliyeitwa Monduli ambaye aliishi katika eneo hilo wakati wa ukoloni wa Wajerumani. Wajerumani waliitawala Tanzania katika miaka ya 1880, na waliinza pia mfumo wa elimu ya Ulaya uliokuwa ukifundisha masomo kama sayansi, hisabati, uhandisi na hata lugha ya Kijerumani. Tanzania ilipata uhuru tarehe 9 Desemba 1961 chini ya uongozi wa Rais wa kwanza, Julius Nyerere.
Taarifa za Jumla
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Monduli ilianzishwa wakati wa utawala wa kikoloni wa Waingereza, ambapo eneo la kiutawala liliitwa “Monduli Maasai District.” Wakati huo, wilaya hiyo ilijumuisha pia maeneo ambayo kwa sasa ni wilaya za Kiteto District, Simanjiro District, Ngorongoro District na Longido District.
Mwaka 1979, Wilaya ya Kiteto ilitengwa kutoka katika Wilaya ya Monduli Maasai. Wakati huo, Wilaya ya Simanjiro ilikuwa bado ni sehemu ya Kiteto. Tangu wakati huo, jina la wilaya lilibaki kuwa Monduli , huku Wilaya ya Ngorongoro ikiendelea kuwa sehemu yake hadi miaka ya 1980.
Mwaka 2005, Wilaya ya Longido nayo ilitengwa kutoka Wilaya ya Monduli. Hivyo, Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Monduli sasa ni mojawapo ya halmashauri saba za wilaya katika Mkoa wa Arusha.
Kijiografia, Wilaya ya Monduli ipo kati ya latitudo 3.00° hadi 4.50° kusini mwa Ikweta na longitudo 36.50° hadi 36.45° mashariki mwa Meridian ya Greenwich.
Mipaka ya Wilaya
Wilaya ya Monduli inapakana na:
Wilaya ya Arumeru District upande wa mashariki
Wilaya za Ngorongoro District na Karatu District upande wa magharibi
Wilaya za Mbulu District na Babati District upande wa kusini
Wilaya ya Simanjiro District upande wa kusini mashariki
Wilaya ya Longido District upande wa kaskazini

pages.text_en:
VISION
Having a community with sustainable high Quality Standard of Living.
MISSION
To provide high Quality Social-economic services to the District population through effective and efficient use of Resources with values of good governance.
pages.text_sw:
Dira (VISION)
Kuwa na jamii yenye maisha bora na endelevu yenye viwango vya juu vya maisha.
Dhima (MISSION)
Kutoa huduma bora za kijamii na kiuchumi kwa wakazi wa wilaya kupitia matumizi bora na yenye ufanisi ya rasilimali, kwa kuzingatia misingi ya utawala bora.

pages.menu_path: About Us > Core Values > Core Values
pages.title: Core Values
pages.text_en:
Core Values
1. Integrity
Performing duties with honesty, transparency, and in compliance with laws, regulations, and the ethics of public service.
2. Accountability
Being responsible for our actions and decisions in the use of public resources and the delivery of services to citizens.
3. Efficiency and Effectiveness
Using available resources efficiently to achieve the best possible results in service delivery.
4. Transparency
Providing accurate and timely information about the council’s activities and decisions to citizens and stakeholders.
5. Participation
Ensuring that citizens and stakeholders are fully involved in planning, implementation, and evaluation of development activities.
6. Equity and Fairness
Providing services fairly and equally without discrimination based on gender, ethnicity, religion, or social status.
7. Innovation
Encouraging new ideas, technologies, and best practices to improve service delivery.
8. Commitment to Service
Delivering quality services to citizens with dedication, professionalism, and a spirit of public service.
pages.text_sw:
Maadili ya Msingi
1. Uadilifu
Kutekeleza majukumu kwa uaminifu, uwazi na kwa kuzingatia sheria, kanuni na maadili ya utumishi wa umma.
2. Uwajibikaji
Kuwajibika kwa matendo na maamuzi yetu katika matumizi ya rasilimali za umma na utoaji wa huduma kwa wananchi.
3. Ufanisi na Utekelezaji Bora
Kutumia rasilimali zilizopo kwa ufanisi ili kufikia matokeo bora katika utoaji wa huduma.
4. Uwazi
Kutoa taarifa sahihi na kwa wakati kuhusu shughuli na maamuzi ya halmashauri kwa wananchi na wadau.
5. Ushirikishwaji
Kuhakikisha wananchi na wadau wanashirikishwa kikamilifu katika mipango, utekelezaji na tathmini ya shughuli za maendeleo.
6. Usawa na Haki
Kutoa huduma kwa haki na usawa bila ubaguzi wa jinsia, kabila, dini au hali ya kijamii.
7. Ubunifu
Kuhamasisha mawazo mapya, matumizi ya teknolojia na mbinu bora ili kuboresha utoaji wa huduma.
8. Kujituma katika Huduma
Kutoa huduma bora kwa wananchi kwa kujitolea, weledi na kwa kuzingatia misingi ya utumishi wa umma.

Council's Objectives
A: Services improved and HIV/AIDS infections reduced
B: Access to and equitable social services improved
C: Ecosystem and protection of Natural resource managed
D: Good Governance and Council administrative services enhanced
E: Economic growth with particular focus on Rural areas improved
F: Quantity and Quality economic services improved
G: Emergency preparedness and disaster management improved
H: Social welfare, Gender and Community empowerment improved
pages.text_sw:
Malengo ya Halmashauri
A: Utoaji wa huduma umeboreshwa na maambukizi ya UKIMWI/VVU yamepungua.
B: Upatikanaji wa huduma za kijamii na usawa katika utoaji wa huduma hizo umeboreshwa.
C: Mifumo ya ikolojia na ulinzi wa rasilimali za asili unasimamiwa ipasavyo.
D: Utawala bora na huduma za kiutawala za halmashauri zimeimarishwa.
E: Ukuaji wa uchumi umeboreshwa kwa kuzingatia zaidi maendeleo ya maeneo ya vijijini.
F: Wingi na ubora wa huduma za kiuchumi umeboreshwa.
G: Maandalizi ya kukabiliana na dharura na usimamizi wa majanga umeboreshwa.
H: Ustawi wa jamii, usawa wa kijinsia na uwezeshaji wa jamii umeboreshwa.

pages.title: Administration and Human Resource Management Division
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To provide expertise and services on human resource management and administrative matters to the council
Functions:
i. To interpret Public Service Regulations, Standing Orders and other Labour laws
ii. To oversee the implementation of ethics and value promotion activities including corruption prevention education
iii. To administer and oversee implementation of activities such as recruitment, selection, orientation, training and employee development, promotion, discipline, retention, motivation, performance management and general staff welfare
iv. To ensure optimal efficient and effective management and utilization of human resource
v. To coordinate Workers Council and Trade Union affairs
vi. To oversee the development and implementation of effective policies, procedures and guidelines for recruitment, training and development, deployment, retention of staffs, promotions, performance management
vii. To conduct regular human resources audit and inventory of current and needed skills
viii. To provide registry, mesengerial and courier services; and manage office records
ix. To handle protocol matters
x. To facilitate provision of security services, transport and general utilities
xi. To facilitate maintenance of office equipment, buildings and grounds
xii. To coordinate implementation of ethics and value promotion activities
xiii. To coordinate implementation of Diversity issues
xiv. To coordinate implementation of private sector Participation, Business Process Improvement and Client Services Charter; and
xv. To provide advice on organizational efficiency of the office
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kutoa utaalamu na huduma kuhusu usimamizi wa rasilimali watu na masuala ya utawala kwa Halmashauri.
Majukumu:
i. Kufasiri Kanuni za Utumishi wa Umma, Kanuni za Kudumu za Utumishi wa Umma na sheria nyingine za kazi.
ii. Kusimamia utekelezaji wa shughuli za kukuza maadili na misingi ya kiutendaji, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa elimu ya kuzuia rushwa.
iii. Kusimamia na kuendesha utekelezaji wa shughuli kama vile ajira, uteuzi, mafunzo elekezi, na maendeleo ya wafanyakazi, upandishaji vyeo, nidhamu, motisha, usimamizi wa utendaji kazi, na ustawi wa wafanyakazi kwa ujumla.
iv. Kuhakikisha usimamizi na matumizi bora na yenye tija ya rasilimali watu.
v. Kuratibu masuala ya Baraza la Wafanyakazi na vyama vya wafanyakazi.
vi. Kusimamia uandaaji na utekelezaji wa sera, taratibu, na miongozo thabiti ya ajira, mafunzo na maendeleo, upangaji wa vituo vya kazi, utunzaji wa wafanyakazi, upandishaji vyeo, na usimamizi wa utendaji kazi.
vii. Kufanya ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara wa rasilimali watu na orodha ya ujuzi uliopo na unaohitajika.
viii. Kutoa huduma za masjala, upokeaji na usafirishaji wa barua/vifurushi, na kusimamia kumbukumbu za ofisi.
ix. Kushughulikia masuala ya itifaki.
x. Kuwezesha upatikanaji wa huduma za ulinzi, usafiri, na huduma nyinginezo za kijamii.
xi. Kuwezesha matengenezo ya vifaa vya ofisi, majengo, na mazingira ya ofisi.
xii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa shughuli za kukuza maadili na misingi ya kiutendaji.
xiii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa masuala anuai
xiv. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa ushiriki wa sekta binafsi, uboreshaji wa mifumo ya utendaji kazi na Mkataba wa Huduma kwa Mteja; na
xv. Kutoa ushauri kuhusu ufanisi wa kimuundo wa ofisi.

pages.title: Planning and Coordination Division
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To provide expertise and services in planning, budgeting, monitoring and evaluation
Functions:
i. To prepare mid- and long-term strategies, plans and budget
ii. To prepare and review LGA’s economic profile
iii. To coordinate implementation of private sector participation
iv. Coordinate Council Disaster Management
v. To coordinate LGA’s activities implemented by other institutions such as land and water
vi. To develop guidelines on research and innovation matters for the LGA
vii. To coordinate research and innovation matters for making informed decisions
viii. To coordinate management of innovation matters
ix. To cooperate with national and international research institutions and data centers for the purpose of collecting and exchanging research and innovation information
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kutoa utaalamu na huduma katika mipango, upangaji wa bajeti, ufuatiliaji na tathmini.
Majukumu:
i. Kuandaa mikakati, mipango, na bajeti za muda wa kati na mrefu.
ii. Kuandaa na kupitia wasifu wa kiuchumi wa Mamlaka ya Serikali ya Mitaa.
iii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa ushiriki wa sekta binafsi.
iv. Kuratibu usimamizi wa maafa katika Halmashauri.
v. Kuratibu shughuli za Mamlaka ya Serikali ya Mitaa zinazotekelezwa na taasisi nyingine kama vile sekta za ardhi na maji.
vi. Kuandaa miongozo kuhusu masuala ya utafiti na ubunifu kwa ajili ya Mamlaka ya Serikali ya Mitaa.
vii. Kuratibu masuala ya utafiti na ubunifu kwa ajili ya kufanya maamuzi yenye ushahidi.
viii. Kuratibu usimamizi wa masuala ya ubunifu.
ix. Kushirikiana na taasisi za utafiti za kitaifa na kimataifa pamoja na vituo vya takwimu kwa ajili ya kukusanya na kubadilishana taarifa za utafiti na ubunifu.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Divisions > Community Development Division
pages.title: Community Development Division
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To supervise community development activities in LGA
Functions:
i. To analyze, interpret and supervise implementation of policies, laws and procedures related to community development
ii. To facilitate communities to initiate, plan, implement and evaluate their own programs and projects
iii. To prepare short and long term plans and projects in community development at LGA level
iv. To conduct research and recommend on how to deal with various development problems that uphold community development in collaboration with the Ministry responsible for community development and other stakeholders
v. To regulate and supervise operation of microfinance services providers tier four under directives of Bank Of Tanzania (BOT)
vi. To coordinate and manage economic development activities for women, children and persons with disabilities
vii. To coordinate provision of training on poverty alleviation, AIDS, drugs and gender equality
viii. To coordinate and monitor NGOs and CBOs activities in community development; and
ix. To coordinate and manage community development activities in LGA
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kusimamia shughuli za maendeleo ya jamii katika Halmashauri za Serikali za Mitaa (LGA).
Majukumu:
i. Kuchambua, kufasiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu zinazohusiana na maendeleo ya jamii.
ii. Kuwezesha jamii kuanzisha, kupanga, kutekeleza na kutathmini mipango na miradi yao wenyewe.
iii. Kuandaa mipango na miradi ya muda mfupi na mrefu ya maendeleo ya jamii katika ngazi ya mamlaka za serikali za mitaa.
iv. Kufanya tafiti na kutoa mapendekezo juu ya namna ya kushughulikia changamoto mbalimbali za maendeleo kwa kushirikiana na Wizara inayohusika na maendeleo ya jamii na wadau wengine.
v. Kudhibiti na kusimamia shughuli za watoa huduma za mikopo midogomidogo (microfinance) daraja la nne chini ya maagizo ya Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BOT).
vi. Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za maendeleo ya kiuchumi kwa wanawake, watoto na watu wenye ulemavu.
vii. Kuratibu utoaji wa mafunzo juu ya kupunguza umaskini, UKIMWI, dawa za kulevya na usawa wa kijinsia.
viii. Kuratibu na kufuatilia shughuli za shughuli za mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali (NGOs) katika maendeleo ya jamii.
ix. Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za maendeleo ya jamii katika mamlaka za serikali a mitaa.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Divisions > Secondary Education Division
pages.title: Secondary Education Division
pages.text_en:
Objectives
To coordinate implementation of secondary education policies, plans, laws, circulars and guidelines.
Functions
i. To supervise the administration of continuous assessments and national form two, four and six examinations
ii. To conduct monitoring and evaluation on implementation of secondary education plans and programs
iii. To supervise delivery of adult and non formal education at secondary level
iv. To create and maintain database on secondary education
v. To coordinate life skills education in secondary schools
vi. To coordinate and supervise secondary schools’ sports and games
vii. To conduct needs assessment for special needs, adult and non formal education; and
viii. To provide advice on establishment and maintenance of special needs, adult and non formal education centres
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, mipango, sheria na miongozo inayohusiana na elimu ya sekondari.
Majukumu:
i. Kusimamia utendaji wa tathmini endelevu na mitihani ya kitaifa ya kidato cha pili, cha nne na cha sita.
ii. Kufanya ufuatiliaji na tathmini ya utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za elimu ya sekondari.
iii. Kusimamia utoaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika ngazi ya sekondari.
iv. Kuunda na kudumisha kanzidata (database) ya elimu ya sekondari.

Monduli District Investment Profile
1.1 Geographical Location
Monduli District Council was established during the British colonial era and was originally named “Monduli Maasai District” , which included the present-day districts of Kiteto, Simanjiro, Ngorongoro, and Longido. In 1979, Kiteto District was created from Monduli Maasai District (at that time, Simanjiro was still part of Kiteto). Since then, the district retained the name Monduli . Ngorongoro District remained part of Monduli until the 1980s, and in 2005, Longido District was also formed from Monduli.
Today, Monduli District Council is one of the seven councils in Arusha Region , alongside Arusha City, Arusha District, Ngorongoro District, Meru District, Karatu District, and Longido District.
Monduli District is located between latitudes 3.00° to 4.50° South of the Equator and longitudes 36.50° to 36.45° East of the Greenwich Meridian. It is bordered by Arumeru District to the East, Ngorongoro and Karatu Districts to the West, Mbulu and Babati Districts to the South, Simanjiro District to the South-East, and Longido District to the North.
1.2 Administrative Structure and Land Area
The District is administratively divided into three divisions : Manyara, Makuyuni, and Kisongo; 20 wards ; and 62 villages . Monduli District covers a total area of 6,419 sq. km , of which 6,290.62 sq. km is land and 128.38 sq. km is water.
Land use distribution:
Grazing land: 3,983.855 sq. km
Arable land: 1,055.475 sq. km
Forest area: 374.965 sq. km
1.3 Demography
1.3.1 Ethnic Groups
The major ethnic group is the Wamaasai , constituting about 40% of the population, mainly engaged in livestock keeping. The Waarusha make up about 20% and are involved in both livestock keeping and farming. The remaining 40% comprises non-indigenous groups engaged in farming, trade, and civil service.
1.3.2 Population Size and Growth
According to the 2022 Population Census , Monduli District had a population of 227,585 (104,742 males and 122,843 females), with an annual growth rate of 3.77% from 2012 to 2022.
1.4 Climate and Soils
Monduli is among the driest districts in Tanzania. Low-altitude areas have a warm climate, while high-altitude areas are cooler. Temperatures range from 20°C to 35°C , with rainfall between less than 500 mm in lowlands to 900 mm at higher elevations.
Climatic Zones:
Highlands: Cool, sub-humid; average temperature 20°C; rainfall ~1,000 mm/year.
Flat and Rolling Plains: Semi-arid; temperatures 20°C–30°C; rainfall 400–600 mm/year.
Rift Valley: Arid; temperatures 23°C–35°C; rainfall <500 mm/year.
Soils:
Shallow soils: <40–50 cm, low fertility and water retention.
Deep soils: >40–50 cm, may have poor drainage but high fertility.
Deep, freely drained soils: >40–50 cm, good for agriculture. Subtypes:
Clay soils: Moderate fertility
Loamy soils: Found on plains, slopes, and hills
Sandy soils: Low water retention, occur along streams
1.5 Topography
The landscape features isolated mountains ( Monduli, Lepurko, Loosimingori, Lengai ) and rolling plains, with altitudes from 600 m to 2,900 m . Vegetation includes forests, bushlands, wooded grasslands, and grasslands.
Rivers: Major perennial rivers include Simba, Kirurumo, Mto wa Mbu, Selela (Kabambe), and Engaruka.
1.5.1 Agro-Ecological Zones
Highland Zone: Altitudes ~2,000 m; deep, fertile loamy soils; forests on hilltops; main activities: livestock and crop farming (maize, beans, barley/wheat; small-scale coffee and banana).
Lowland Zone: Altitudes 600–1,200 m; deep, freely drained clay soils; main activities: extensive livestock keeping and crop farming (maize, beans, paddy, banana, small-scale sunflower). Livestock includes cattle, goats, sheep, donkeys, and camels.
2.0 Economic Activities
Key economic activities include livestock keeping, agriculture, and wildlife . Over 90% of the population engages in livestock and farming. The district has 105,547.5 hectares of potential arable land, of which 87,632.5 hectares (13.65%) are under cultivation. Subsistence farming predominates, with maize, beans, and paddy as staple crops; coffee and sunflower are grown on a small scale. Livestock keeping is a major economic activity with high potential for growth.
2.2 Natural Resources
Forests: Out of the district's 641,900 hectares , 23,022 hectares are designated forest reserves as follows

TREE PLANTING:
Large areas of the District are bare as result of tree cutting over years and wildfires. In order to address the situation, the District Council has embarked on 15,000,000 trees National tree planting and reforestation programme annually . The programme implemented by the District Council, Individuals, schools and various institutions. Droughts and destruction by livestock have been the major restrictions to the survival of planted trees.
FISH INDUSTRY
Fishing is practiced locally at Lake Manyara in Mto wa Mbu area at a verysmallscale- not only because the District lacks large water bodies but also because of cultural value problems of the communities (Wamaasai) and inferior fishing gear used. Fish consumed in town/ trading centres in Monduli District are brought from Lake Mdori in Babati, Nyumba ya Mungu Dam in Simanjiro, Lake Eyasi in Karatu, from Lake Victoria and Indian Ocean(Tanga). For several years back Monduli lacks a fisheries officer who could collect data and manage fishing industry.

3.1 ROAD NETWORK
The Disitrict is not well served with economic infrastructure. It has a total road network of 617kms. Tarmac road been 8.1 km, 138 km gravel and 470.9 km is earth surfaced road. Trunk roads (96km) and Regional roads (156km). District roads, feeder roads and village access roads are mostly earth surfaced - they are passable with difficult during rainy seasons. This is a result of lack of lack of funds and equipment for reqular maitenance. Monduli is served electricity
3.2 AIR TRANSPORT:
Monduli District is served with Arusha Airport(Kisongo) which is nearly 35 km. from Monduli Town, Also Kilimanjaro International Airport about 90km from Mondui. Inside the District we have Makuyuni Airstripnwhich accommodates light aircrafts.
3.3 RAILWAY TRANSPORT:
The District is not served by railway lines.
3.4 COMMUNICATION
The District is served with telephone the lines and radio calls- It has sub Post Offices and Telephone Office at Monduli Headquarters, Mto wa Mbu and Makuyuni. It is also served by cellular phones covering nearly 100% of the district.

Fursa za Uwekezaji
Profaili ya Uwekezaji Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Monduli
1.1 Eneo la Kijiografia
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Monduli ilianzishwa wakati wa utawala wa kikoloni wa Uingereza na awali ilijulikana kama “Wilaya ya Monduli Maasai” , ambayo ilikuwa ikijumuisha wilaya za sasa za Kiteto, Simanjiro, Ngorongoro, na Longido. Mwaka 1979, Wilaya ya Kiteto ilitengenezwa kutoka Wilaya ya Monduli Maasai (wakati huo, Simanjiro bado ilikuwa sehemu ya Kiteto). Tangu wakati huo, jina la Wilaya lilibaki Monduli . Wilaya ya Ngorongoro iliendelea kuwa sehemu ya Monduli hadi miaka ya 1980, na mwaka 2005 Wilaya ya Longido pia ilitengenezwa kutoka Monduli.
Hivi sasa, Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Monduli ni moja ya halmashauri saba katika Mkoa wa Arusha, pamoja na Jiji la Arusha, Wilaya ya Arusha, Wilaya ya Ngorongoro, Wilaya ya Meru, Wilaya ya Karatu, na Wilaya ya Longido.
Wilaya ya Monduli ipo kati ya latitudo 3.00° hadi 4.50° Kusini na longitudo 36.50° hadi 36.45° Mashariki ya Meridian ya Greenwich. Inapakana na Wilaya ya Arumeru upande wa Mashariki, Wilaya za Ngorongoro na Karatu upande wa Magharibi, Wilaya za Mbulu na Babati upande wa Kusini, Wilaya ya Simanjiro kusini-mashariki, na Wilaya ya Longido kaskazini.
1.2 Muundo wa Utawala na Eneo la Ardhi
Wilaya hii imegawanywa kijiografia katika mikoa mitatu : Manyara, Makuyuni, na Kisongo; kata 20 ; na vijiji 62 . Wilaya ya Monduli ina eneo la jumla la km² 6,419 , ambapo km² 6,290.62 ni ardhi na km² 128.38 ni maji.
Matumizi ya ardhi:
Ardhi ya malisho: 3,983.855 km²
Ardhi shambani: 1,055.475 km²
Misitu: 374.965 km²
1.3 Idadi ya Watu
1.3.1 Makabila
Kikabila kikuu ni Wamaasai , ambacho kinaunda takriban 40% ya idadi ya watu, kikihusiana zaidi na ufugaji. Waarusha wanaunda 20% na wanahusika na ufugaji na kilimo. 40% iliyobaki ni makundi yasiyo ya asili, yanayojihusisha na kilimo, biashara, na utumishi wa umma.
1.3.2 Idadi ya Watu na Ukuaji
Kulingana na Sensa ya Watu ya 2022 , Wilaya ya Monduli ilikuwa na idadi ya watu 227,585 (wanaume 104,742 na wanawake 122,843), na kiwango cha ukuaji wa kila mwaka 3.77% kutoka 2012 hadi 2022.
1.4 Hali ya Hewa na Udongo
Monduli ni moja ya wilaya kavu zaidi Tanzania. Eneo la chini lina hali ya hewa ya joto, na eneo la juu lina baridi kidogo. Halijoto zinatofautiana kutoka 20°C hadi 35°C , na mvua kutoka chini ya 500 mm katika maeneo ya chini hadi 900 mm katika maeneo ya juu.
Mikoa ya Hali ya Hewa:
Milima ya Juu: Baridi kidogo, sub-humid; halijoto wastani 20°C; mvua ~1,000 mm/ mwaka.
Maporomoko ya Nchi: Nusu-kavu; halijoto 20°C–30°C; mvua 400–600 mm/ mwaka.
Bonde la Ufa: Kavu; halijoto 23°C–35°C; mvua <500 mm/ mwaka.
Aina za Udongo:
Udongo Ufishefu: <40–50 cm, nguvu ya rutuba na uhifadhi wa maji mdogo.
Udongo Kina: >40–50 cm, unaweza kuwa na mmomonyoko duni lakini rutuba ya juu.
Udongo Kina, Usiozuilika: >40–50 cm, mzuri kwa kilimo. Subaina:
Udongo wa udongo (Clay): Rutuba wastani
Udongo wa mchanga (Loamy): Upatikana kwenye tambarare, mabonde, na milima
Udongo wa mchanga (Sandy): Uhifadhi mdogo wa maji, hupatikana kando ya mito
1.5 Jiografia na Milima
Eneo lina milima iliyotengwa (Monduli, Lepurko, Loosimingori, Lengai) na tambarare zenye milima midogo, altitudo kutoka 600 m hadi 2,900 m . Mimea ni mchanganyiko wa misitu, nyika, mabwawa ya misitu na nyasi.
Mito: Mito mikuu ya kudumu ni Simba, Kirurumo, Mto wa Mbu, Selela (Kabambe), na Engaruka.
1.5.1 Mikoa ya Kilimo Kijiografia
Eneo la Milima: Altitudo ~2,000 m; udongo wa loamy mzuri na rutuba ya asili; misitu juu ya milima; shughuli kuu: ufugaji na kilimo cha chakula na biashara (mahindi, maharage, shayiri/ngano; kahawa na ndizi kwa kiwango kidogo).
Eneo la Nchi za Chini: Altitudo 600–1,200 m; udongo wa clay mzuri na usiozuilika; shughuli kuu: ufugaji mkubwa na kilimo (mahindi, maharage, mpunga, ndizi, alizeti kwa kiwango kidogo). Mifugo ni pamoja na ng’ombe, mbuzi, kondoo, punda, na ngamia.
2.0 Shughuli za Uchumi
Shughuli kuu za uchumi ni ufugaji, kilimo, na wanyamapori. Zaidi ya 90% ya watu wanajihusisha na ufugaji na kilimo. Wilaya ina hektari 105,547.5 za ardhi shambani zenye uwezo, ambapo 87,632.5 hektari (13.65%) zimekuwa shambani. Kilimo cha kujikimu kinatawala; mahindi, maharage, na mpunga ni vyakula vya msingi; kahawa na alizeti vinapandwa kwa kiwango kidogo. Ufugaji ni shughuli kuu yenye uwezekano mkubwa wa ukuaji.

Upandaji wa Miti:
Maeneo makubwa ya wilaya yamekuwa tupu kutokana na ukataji miti na moto wa porini. Halmashauri ya Wilaya inatekeleza mpango wa kitaifa wa upandaji miti 15,000,000 kila mwaka , ukishirikiana na watu binafsi, shule, na taasisi mbalimbali. Changamoto kuu ni ukame na mifugo.
2.3 Sekta ya Samaki
Uvuvi unafanyika kwa kiwango kidogo kwenye Ziwa Manyara, eneo la Mto wa Mbu. Sababu ni uhaba wa maji makubwa, utamaduni wa Wamaasai, na vifaa duni vya uvuvi. Samaki wanaoliuzwa Monduli wanatoka Ziwa Mdori (Babati), Bwawa la Nyumba ya Mungu (Simanjiro), Ziwa Eyasi (Karatu), Ziwa Victoria, na Bahari ya Hindi (Tanga). 3.0 Miundombinu ya Uchumi
3.1 Barabara:
Jumla ya mtandao wa barabara ni 617 km ; barabara ya lami 8.1 km, lami ya mchanga 138 km, na barabara ya udongo 470.9 km. Barabara kuu 96 km, mikoa 156 km. Barabara za wilaya, vijijini na za kufikia mashamba zinakuwa na changamoto za mvua kutokana na ukosefu wa vifaa na fedha.
3.2 Usafiri wa Anga:
Wilaya inafikiwa na Uwanja wa Ndege Arusha (Kisongo) ~35 km kutoka Monduli, na Uwanja wa Ndege wa Kimataifa Kilimanjaro ~90 km. Pia kuna Airstrip ya Makuyuni kwa ndege ndogo.
